items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Kirby's Band, except for "Gone With The Wind", it was on all of those early recordings of mine... it was Kirby's group.

ctx.x: And you - he began to back you in your records and so on. Would you tell us a little bit about what kind of person he was?

Kirby's Band, except for "Gone With The Wind", it was on all of those early recordings of mine, but my band just happened to be under the direction of Claude Thornhill, but it was Kirby's group.
Kirby began to contact different arrangements especially a Lou Singer who was a group who was working for leads usually, and I think that Kurby must have decided maybe that the singing of these classics might be a good idea for his combination, otherwise it would have been just another jazz group. And so he engage Lou…
